1.e4 c5 2.d3 Nc6 3.c3.strategy: Gives the centre a firm base: c3 supports a later d4 and takes the c3 square from the queen's knight. White builds slowly and solidly, keeping options open and avoiding any early theory.

1.e4 c5 2.d3 Nc6 3.c3 d6.strategy: Builds a solid chain, opens the c8-bishop and prepares to challenge White's centre. Black keeps the position healthy and flexible and avoids a pawn structure that White could attack.
